title: Group/Community Card
content: Build group/community card component. Visual: cover image, group avatar/icon, name, description. Stats: member count, posts per week. Join button: Join/Joined toggle. Privacy: public/private indicator. Admin badges. Category tags. Member avatars preview. Last activity timestamp.

variants.simple: Create group or community preview card with join button.
variants.detailed: Build group/community card component. Visual: cover image, group avatar/icon, name, description. Stats: member count, posts per week. Join button: Join/Joined toggle. Privacy: public/private indicator. Admin badges. Category tags. Member avatars preview. Last activity timestamp.
variants.advanced: Build comprehensive group/community card for discovery and management. Card container: bg-white rounded-xl shadow-sm overflow-hidden hover:shadow-md transition-shadow. Cover image: h-24 object-cover w-full, gradient overlay at bottom for text readability. Group avatar: w-16 h-16 rounded-xl border-4 border-white, positioned overlapping cover with -mt-8 ml-4, could be icon/emoji on colored bg or uploaded image. Card content: px-4 pb-4 pt-2. Group name: text-lg font-bold line-clamp-1, verified/official badge if applicable. Privacy indicator: inline badge next to name, "Public" (Globe icon) or "Private" (Lock icon), text-xs text-gray-500. Description: text-sm text-gray-600 line-clamp-2 mt-1. Category tags: flex gap-2 mt-2, small pills (Tech, Gaming, Music). Stats row: flex gap-4 mt-3 text-sm text-gray-500. Member count: Users icon + "12.4K members". Activity: MessageCircle icon + "50+ posts/week" or "Very active". Admin section: small avatars of admins, "Managed by [Name]". Member preview: overlapping avatar stack of 3-5 members, "+2.4K more". Your connection: "5 friends are members" with tiny friend avatars. Join button: w-full mt-4. States: "Join" (primary bg-blue-500 text-white), "Pending" (for private groups, outline disabled), "Joined" (outline with check, hover shows "Leave"). Request to join: for private groups, Join sends request. Invite button: if already member, option to invite friends. Rules/guidelines preview: "3 rules - Read before joining" expandable. Mute option: for joined groups, mute notifications. Notification bell: toggle notification level (All, Highlights, None). Leave: in dropdown menu with confirmation. Pinned groups: star/pin groups for quick access. Group type indicators: badges for "Official", "Verified", "Featured". Analytics for admins: member growth, engagement stats. Mobile: cards in scrollable list or grid. Accessibility: card as article, join button clearly labeled with group name, interactive elements focusable.
